en: Black‑and‑white view over the rooftops of an old European town. In the foreground are densely packed, steep‑roofed houses and some trees. Dominating the center is a very large Gothic church with a massive, plain sloping roof and a tall spire. To the left and right stand additional church or town‑hall towers with Baroque-style spires. On the right edge there is a stout medieval defensive tower with a conical roof, suggesting preserved city walls. The sky is blank and bright, with no visible text or border decorations.
